notes.title: Cubway Trading Cards are available Now !
notes.content:
Great news!!!
Now you can receive trading cards, while playing Cubway. Trade, craft badges and get astonishing backgrounds and emoticons! 

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/25956993/7108684000d44f8b7390776d26f84a292764e49d.jpg[/img]
